source.title: When the RIZZ is TOO GOOD #relatable #meme #funny #skit #comedy

transcript: When a girl you like asks you if you're up, what's the best way to respond? With a funny joke? Or with a confident flirt? Answer is... It depends. If it's Lizzie, a witty joke a day will make her fall in love with you right away. From that ping pong game against you today? Yeah, I'm still up. If it's Rachel, she's a little wild so something risky will be perfect. Yeah, I'm up. If you know the kind of fish you're up against, you'll know the exact kind of bait you need to use to reel it in. If you don't? Well, it'll probably just ignore you and swim far, far away until you've completely lost sight of it. Um, that's a little quick though. Sorry, I'm looking for something long term. We can be friends though. It was the wrong bait. Or rather, the wrong fish. See, I thought salmon was like the others. Small betta fish waiting to get caught. But she was something much, much bigger. I had used the wrong bait on her, but hear me out. I've been talking to Sammy for two months now, taken her out on two dates, met her dog, yada yada yada, and now she was swimming away. But I didn't lose sight of her just yet. You know I don't want to just be friends with you. Well, what do you want to be then? Something long term? Yeah. Saying yes to her was like my free get out of jail card. She basically just handed it to me, and all I had to do was take it. But my intention with her was to have a bit of fun, not to be her boyfriend. I ain't no liar. I'll be straightforward with you. I'm not looking for a long term relationship right now, but I think you're really cute, and I always look forward to hanging with you. Okay. I respect your decision if you want to end things here, but I just want you to know you're not just some random girl I don't care about. I can't tell if you actually care or if you're just desperate. You think I would have happily dog sat dumpling for you despite my allergy to dogs if I didn't care? Okay, true. How many other girls are you talking to, talking to, or crushing on? Because depending on which one, one is the answer. I just don't want to get hurt from this. Just don't fall in love with me. I know, I know. It might be hard. My dad has a shotgun FYI. I'm more scared of your allergy filled dog. You see, when other people try to fish, they're fishing in the whole ocean where the fish can get away. When I'm fishing, it's in a confined tank. No matter how far away the fish tries to swim, I'll always be able to catch it.
